tipsterSupport.title: Tipster Support
tipsterSupport.body: From 1 December: verified members who win 10 picks in a row unlock Tipster Support, and other members can back them with PuntPoints to get their picks copied as they post. Points have no cash value, can't be withdrawn and never affect rankings.
